title: Steam fix playbook (5 common issues)
notes: Umbrella: unify detect → Guidance insight → fix script → optional one-click Fix for recurring Linux/Steam breakages. (1) Corrupt / incomplete install — DONE game-files-corrupt via steam_install_health + steam://validate. (2) Pending update / shader cache — extend same helper: BytesToDownload, suspended-while-running, optional shadercache/<appid> clear script. (3) Missing gaming libraries — diagnostics _check_libraries today; add insight game-libs-missing with apt one-liner (libvulkan1, mesa-vulkan-drivers, libgl1, i386 multilib, libldap2, gamemode). (4) Steam disk too low — diagnostics disk-steam-low; add insight steam-disk-low with prefix cleanup + Settings → Storage steps, block launch if <8 GB. (5) Proton prefix / bad exit — gameprocess_log exit 137/139 + compatdata errors; insight game-prefix-reset with scripted backup/delete compatdata/<appid>, relaunch notes, winetricks pointer. Bonus later: Vulkan broken (vulkaninfo), Wayland launch template when Cosmic session detected. Surface active-game hits in Guidance; full-library scan in Troubleshooting.

title: Game launch / crash session detector
notes: steam_launch_health(appid): parse ~/.steam/steam/logs/gameprocess_log.txt into sessions. Root launcher = first 'adding PID' line with quoted steam-launch-wrapper/reaper cmd; session ends at 'Remove <appid> from running list' — use root PID exit code (ignore child exit -1 noise). Signals: FAILED_START root exit 127/126/1 within ~30s; CRASH 139 (SIGSEGV) or 137 (SIGKILL); SUSPECT_SHORT root exit 0/130 but session <90s (flash quit); CLEAN 0 or 130 longer session. Secondary: content_log Files Corrupt (already), console-linux FATAL/dlopen failed, compatdata/*/logs, journalctl --user segfault after launch. Guidance insight game-needs-diag when last session FAILED_START/CRASH or 2+ SUSPECT_SHORT in 24h — route to steam-fix-playbook script (verify, libs, prefix reset). Diagnostics scan all installed AppIDs; show last exit + duration in Troubleshooting. Done partially today: _check_steam_logs bad exits but no session pairing or root-PID filter.
